name: 44827 · Crestline, OH
findings: ZIP 44827 (Crestline) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44827 (Crestline) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44827 (Crestline) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
